declaration:
--font-forum:
    Arial, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;

--font-hotel-body:
    Tahoma, Arial, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
--font-hotel-heading: Georgia, "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, serif;

background: radial-gradient(
    ellipse,
    transparent 30%,
    #d8d4c00a 40%,
    transparent 44%,
    #c6dcbd1f 47%,
    transparent 53%,
    #0002 60%,
    transparent 69%
  );

filter: grayscale(0.88) sepia(0.2) hue-rotate(38deg) contrast(1.25)
    brightness(0.77);

filter: grayscale(0.7) sepia(0.3) contrast(1.4) brightness(0.7)
    drop-shadow(2px 0 #8b2c2c) drop-shadow(-2px 0 #347376);
content: "↔ Scroll to view all columns";
content: "↔ 可横向查看完整表格";
